about_the_game:
An unsociable detective of the Police Department leads a quiet, uneventful life in a sleepy southern town. But everything changes when his superior assigns him to the case of two missing young people — a search that soon spirals into an inexplicable nightmare full of strange fads. Because the person who reported the disappearance... doesn’t exist in any conventional sense of the word.

Aenigmarch is a visual kinetic novel in the genre of a mystical thriller with elements of surrealism.

Features:

  • Unique, hand-crafted art – Every scene is drawn from scratch: no templates, no repeats — just rich, immersive environments.

  • Switch between noir and color modes – Experience the story in classic black-and-white or full color, depending on your mood.

Mature Content Description

This game includes depictions of alcohol use, smoking, and death. While there is no explicit sexual content, the tone is mature and includes themes of loss, mental instability, and despair. Player discretion is advised.
